planLine: January is quiet, so sell the quiet. Two stories carry the month: a couple's reset weekend and a birder's slow morning. Every email builds the guest circle, whose one privilege is 48 hours of first access to 2027 game weekends. No discounts: the numbers show a discount wipes out what booking direct is worth.

items.builtFrom: Photo: frost on the meadow (Dec 28). Calendar: Jan 8 to 10 open.
items.hook: A new-year note, not a sales email.
items.subject: The meadow this morning
items.copy:
Hi {first name},

The meadow had frost on it at 7 this morning, and the deer came through at 7:40, right on time.

If December was a lot of hosting, January is a good month to be the guest. The weekend of January 8 is open, and so is most of the month midweek.

One more thing: when the 2027 UGA schedule comes out, the guest circle hears first. You'll get 48 hours to pick your game weekends before they open anywhere else.

Happy new year from all eleven acres.
items.cta: Reply with dates, or book on the direct page.

The Christmas Bird Count season wraps up on January 5, so we did our own count on the eleven acres this week: eastern bluebirds, a red-tailed hawk, a pileated woodpecker and more cardinals than we could keep track of.

If you keep a list too, midweek nights are open all January.

items.hook: A long weekend that's easy to say yes to.
items.subject: A three-day weekend, if you want it
items.copy:
Hi {first name},

Monday the 18th is a holiday for a lot of people, and the studio is open Friday the 15th to Monday the 18th.

Three nights is long enough to stop checking your phone. One guest told us they slept better here than at home, and we think it's the dark and the quiet more than the king bed.

If you're dropping a student back in Athens that weekend, campus is about 25 minutes away.
items.cta: Book on the direct page, or reply and ask me anything.

items.builtFrom: Events: UGA spring semester, G-Day, spring commencement (dates to confirm).
items.hook: Useful planning, no booking ask in the first line.
items.subject: Planning your spring trips to Athens
items.copy:
Hi {first name},

If you have a student at UGA, here's the spring as we understand it: classes are back this month, G-Day is in April and commencement is in May. Check the dates on UGA's own pages before you plan.

Commencement sells out every room in town early. If you already know you're coming, it's worth looking now.

And for the quieter visits in between, a single weeknight is fine here. Dinner in Athens, back to the meadow, home by lunch.
items.cta: Reply with your dates and I'll check them.

items.builtFrom: Fact: about 25 minutes to campus. Host's back-roads route card.
items.copy:
Our favorite route into Athens skips the traffic and takes about 25 minutes. We print it for every guest who comes for a game or a visit.

Midweek this month, one night is fine. Take your student to dinner, sleep somewhere quiet, and be home by lunch.

items.subject: How first access to game weekends works
items.copy:
Hi {first name},

The 2027 UGA football schedule isn't out yet. When it is, here's what happens:

I'll email the circle the home game weekends and the time they open to everyone else. You get 48 hours to book first, at the same price everyone else will see. There's no obligation, and the email doesn't hold a date for you.

If you have a friend who's a UGA parent, they can join with the link below.

welcome.subject: Welcome to the guest circle
welcome.body: Glad you're here. About once a month I'll share what's happening on the eleven acres: the birds, the seasons, and anything worth planning around in Athens. When new game weekends open, the circle hears first. If you're already planning a trip, reply and tell me. A real person reads these.

welcome.subject: The part of a game weekend I'd plan first
welcome.body: Before the tickets, think about Friday night. Who arrives late? Does anyone want a simple dinner in? The studio has a full kitchen and a sofa bed for a student who wants to stay over. Getting Friday right makes Saturday easier. If there's something you can't find on the listing, ask me.

welcome.subject: How your first access works
welcome.body: When the schedule comes out, I'll send the home game weekends and the time they open to everyone else. You get 48 hours first, at the same price. There's no obligation, and the email doesn't hold a date for you. It's just a head start.

enquiry.rule: Direct enquiries go cold fast. A short, true holding reply inside five minutes, then the real answer by the time you promised.
enquiry.holding: Thanks for asking about Songbird Acres. I'm checking the dates and will reply by 7 pm today. This message doesn't hold the dates yet.
enquiry.followUp: Is there anything about the studio that would help you decide? Happy to send a photo of the stairs, or the route in from Athens. If plans changed, no problem at all.

offer.decision: No discount this month. Use the privilege instead.
offer.why: A 15% discount turns a direct booking into one worth slightly less than an Airbnb booking. First access costs nothing to deliver and gives UGA parents a real reason to join.
offer.privilegeCost: First access: about $0, and game weekends still sell at full price. If the host wants a returning-guest touch, a jar of the property's pecans costs about $6 (Est.), less than any discount.
offer.ceiling: To beat an Airbnb booking, a direct booking can cost at most about $46 to win (Est.). Skip paid ads until a test shows a lower cost per completed stay.

never: Offer a discount the host didn't ask for, or any discount on a game weekend.
Email anyone who didn't opt in to marketing. Booking messages are not marketing.
Use Airbnb or Vrbo messages to push guests off the platform.
Show a view, amenity or AI-made image that isn't the real property.
Use fake urgency: "only 1 left", countdown timers, "prices going up".
Use a guest's name, face or words without permission, or offer anything for a review.
